title: Brandify Creator
shortDescription: A premium influencer marketing agency website connecting brands with 500+ verified Instagram creators — featuring GSAP animations, glassmorphism UI, and dual registration flows for brands and creators.
overview: Brandify Creator is a high-end influencer marketing agency website built for India's Instagram marketing ecosystem. The platform serves as the digital identity and lead generation engine for Brandify Creator — an agency that connects brands with a curated network of 500+ verified Instagram creators to drive authentic engagement and measurable ROI. The website is built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, enhanced with GSAP 3.12.5 animations and ScrollTrigger for premium scroll-based interactions. It features a dark-themed, glassmorphism design system with floating particles, 3D card tilt effects, and smooth micro-animations. The site includes dedicated registration flows for brands (with pricing packages) and creators (with earning potential highlights), along with comprehensive legal pages.
features: Dual user journeys — separate dedicated pages for Brands and Creators
Hero section with platform statistics (500+ creators, 1M+ reach, 98% success rate)
GSAP-powered animated title reveals and scroll-based section transitions
ScrollTrigger scroll-based animations and parallax effects
Glassmorphism card design with backdrop-filter blur effects
3D card tilt effects with interactive magnetic hover behavior
Floating radial gradient orb background effects
6-step collaboration process visualization (How It Works section)
Brand pricing packages — Starter, Professional, Enterprise tiers
Creator registration form with requirements and earning highlights
Multiple contact touchpoints — Instagram DM, Email, Live Chat
Navbar scroll effects with dynamic glassmorphism on scroll
Gradient text effects and smooth hover micro-interactions
Privacy Policy and Terms of Service pages
Fully responsive mobile-first design with all device breakpoints

architecture.description: Multi-page HTML website with a shared CSS design system and JavaScript animation layer. Pages are linked statically with consistent navigation and footer components across all pages.

myRole: Sole Developer and Designer. Designed and built the entire website from concept to deployment — including the complete design system, GSAP animation implementation, responsive layout, and all page content.
challenges: Implementing smooth, performant GSAP scroll-triggered animations without impacting page load time or causing layout shifts
Creating a premium glassmorphism design that renders consistently across browsers, especially Safari's backdrop-filter support
Building interactive 3D card tilt effects that feel natural and responsive to mouse movement without being jarring on touch devices
Designing a dual-audience website (Brands vs. Creators) with clear visual separation and independent user journeys on the same platform
Achieving a premium, high-fidelity aesthetic using only HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript without any UI framework
solutions: Optimized GSAP animations by using ScrollTrigger's 'once' option for entry animations and leveraging GPU-composited properties (transform, opacity) for 60fps performance
Applied vendor prefixes and graceful degradation for backdrop-filter, with JavaScript-based feature detection to fallback to solid backgrounds on unsupported browsers
Implemented the 3D tilt effect using JavaScript mousemove event listeners with CSS perspective transforms, and disabled the effect on touch devices using pointer media queries
Created distinct hero sections, color accent variations, and tailored CTAs for the Brands page (blue/conversion-focused) vs. Creators page (indigo/aspiration-focused)
Built a complete CSS design system with CSS custom properties for all design tokens, ensuring visual consistency and maintainability across 5 pages
keyLearnings: Advanced GSAP animation techniques including ScrollTrigger, timeline sequencing, and stagger animations for professional web experiences
Building a complete CSS design system from scratch with custom properties, utility classes, and component-level scoping
Designing for dual audiences — creating a single brand identity that speaks authentically to both brands and content creators
Performance optimization for animation-heavy pages — balancing visual richness with smooth 60fps rendering
Creating glassmorphism effects and cross-browser compatible CSS filters
